text: Access Control Policy v3.1 took effect 2025-02-01: quarterly access reviews must explicitly include the finance database.
Data Retention Policy v2.0 took effect 2025-09-15: customer data must be deleted 30 days after contract end.
Incident Response Policy v2.2 took effect 2026-01-10: new severity matrix with a 1-hour response target for Sev-1.

Password and Authentication Policy v4.0 took effect 2026-08-01: minimum password length raised from 12 to 14 characters and MFA is mandatory for all production access including break-glass accounts. Evidence collected before 2026-08-01 no longer demonstrates compliance with control CC6.1.
Vendor Management Policy v2.0 took effect 2026-09-20: vendor access reviews are now quarterly (previously annual) for payment-critical vendors.
